combinations.magnitude: SIN-mediated pain relief disappeared with TGF-β1 knockdown
combinations.evidence_quote: As expected, the SIN‐mediated beneficial effects on pain sensitisation and microglial activation disappeared without TGF‐β1

combinations.magnitude: SIN-mediated microglial inhibition disappeared with TGF-β1 knockdown
combinations.evidence_quote: As expected, the SIN‐mediated beneficial effects on pain sensitisation and microglial activation disappeared without TGF‐β1

combinations.magnitude: ALK5 inhibition reversed SIN-induced rise in PWT and TWL
combinations.evidence_quote: Here, inhibition of spinal ALK5 reversed the rising trends of PWT and TWL in SIN‐treated CCI mice

combinations.magnitude: SIN-induced Iba-1 downregulation blocked by SB-505124
combinations.evidence_quote: The SIN induced Iba‐1 downregulation and p‐Smad3 upregulation in the ipsilateral spinal dorsal horn of CCI mice were also blocked by SB‐505124

combinations.magnitude: SIS3 restrained the SIN-induced rise in PWT and TWL
combinations.evidence_quote: In behavioural tests, inhibition of Smad3 phosphorylation by SIS3 potently restrained the upward trend of PWT and TWL SIN‐treated CCI mice

combinations.magnitude: SIS3 abrogated SIN inhibition of Iba-1
combinations.evidence_quote: Additionally, SIS3 abrogated the inhibitory effect of SIN on Iba‐1 expression in the ipsilateral spinal dorsal horn of CCI mice

combinations.magnitude: TGF-β1 could not reverse LPS stimulation in Smad3 siRNA cells
combinations.evidence_quote: However, the exogenetic TGFβ1 peptide could not reverse the stimulatory effect of LPS on Smad3 siRNA transfected‐BV2 cells.
